name: Something Special
source:
You, who is tired of your daily lifestyle wants something new, something fresh, something SPECIAL!
On a regular night at the gym you met two lovely ladies. Can they be part of what makes your life special tonight or will it turn into another dejected night.
I don't know but it's up to you to find out in this lovely night.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/orborigin]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
厌倦了日常生活的你想要一些新的、新鲜的、特别的东西！
在一个普通的晚上，你在健身房遇到了两位可爱的女士。它们能让你今晚的生活变得特别吗？还是会变成另一个沮丧的夜晚。
我不知道，但这取决于你在这个美丽的夜晚找到答案。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/orborigin]Patreon[/url]]
